-- bookings: confirmadas mas com data passada (deveriam ser 'used' ou 'expired'?)
SELECT COUNT(*) as reservas_confirmadas_passadas,
       MIN(booking_date) as mais_antiga,
       MAX(booking_date) as mais_recente
FROM bookings
WHERE status = 'confirmed' AND booking_date < CURDATE();
